---
title: "Image editing results"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
library(grid)

```

```{r data}
# Change this path if the project folder moves.
project_dir <- "D:/Yelp/Enhance-image-memorability"

export_dir <- Sys.getenv("FIGURE_OUTPUT_DIR", unset = file.path(project_dir, "figures"))

a_candidates <- read_csv(file.path(project_dir, "02_editing/method_a/results_method_a/candidates.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
a <- read_csv(file.path(project_dir, "02_editing/method_a/results_method_a/final_selection.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
b <- read_csv(file.path(project_dir, "02_editing/method_b/results_method_b/candidates.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

sidorov_labels <- c(
  sidorov_vibrance = "Vibrance",
  sidorov_clarity_approx = "Clarity",
  sidorov_sharpening = "Sharpening",
  sidorov_temperature_5000k = "Warmer (5000 K)",
  sidorov_contrast = "Contrast",
  sidorov_vignetting = "Vignetting",
  sidorov_bg_blurring = "Background blur",
  sidorov_bg_blur_darkening = "Background blur + dark",
  sidorov_grayscaling = "Grayscale"
)

arms <- c("A_guided", "A_study1", "A_empty")
# Same selection rule as the notebook: max ResMem per photo/arm before review.
# slice_max(with_ties = FALSE) preserves the first candidate on tied scores.
a_before <- a_candidates |>
  filter(method %in% arms) |>
  group_by(photo, method) |>
  slice_max(resmem, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(check = "Before")
a_after <- a |>
  filter(method %in% arms) |>
  mutate(check = "After")
a_results <- bind_rows(a_before, a_after) |>
  mutate(label = paste(method, check, sep = " / "))

# Guard against stale results after the development set changes.
dev <- read_csv(file.path(project_dir, "01_preprocessing/04_development_set/results/development_photos.csv"),
                show_col_types = FALSE)
dev_ids <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(dev$filename))
stopifnot(setequal(dev_ids, unique(a_candidates$photo)),
          setequal(dev_ids, unique(b$photo)),
          all(a$photo %in% dev_ids),
          !anyDuplicated(a_before[c("photo", "method")]),
          !anyDuplicated(a_after[c("photo", "method")]))
b_results <- b |>
  filter((method == "B1" & rank == 1) | method == "B2") |>
  mutate(label = if_else(method == "B1", "B1 search", "B2 Study 1 rule"))
sidorov_results <- b |>
  filter(candidate %in% names(sidorov_labels)) |>
  mutate(label = unname(sidorov_labels[candidate]))

positions <- tribble(
  ~label, ~y, ~group, ~display_label, ~check_label,
  "A_guided / Before", 17.9, "Method A", "Guided", "Before",
  "A_study1 / Before", 16.9, "Method A", "Study 1", "Before",
  "A_empty / Before", 15.9, "Method A", "Empty", "Before",
  "A_guided / After", 13.7, "Method A", "Guided", "After",
  "A_study1 / After", 12.7, "Method A", "Study 1", "After",
  "A_empty / After", 11.7, "Method A", "Empty", "After",
  "B1 search", 9.1, "Other", "B1 search", "",
  "B2 Study 1 rule", 8.1, "Other", "B2 Study 1 rule", "",
  "Vibrance", 5.6, "Other", "Vibrance", "",
  "Clarity", 4.6, "Other", "Clarity", "",
  "Sharpening", 3.6, "Other", "Sharpening", "",
  "Warmer (5000 K)", 2.6, "Other", "Warmer (5000 K)", "",
  "Contrast", 1.6, "Other", "Contrast", "",
  "Vignetting", 0.6, "Other", "Vignetting", "",
  "Background blur", -0.4, "Other", "Background blur", "",
  "Background blur + dark", -1.4, "Other", "Background blur + dark", "",
  "Grayscale", -2.4, "Other", "Grayscale", ""
)

plot_data <- bind_rows(a_results, b_results, sidorov_results) |>
  group_by(label) |>
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(d_vitmem)),
    vitmem = mean(d_vitmem, na.rm = TRUE),
    vitmem_se = sd(d_vitmem, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),
    n_resmem = sum(!is.na(d_resmem)),
    resmem = mean(d_resmem, na.rm = TRUE),
    resmem_se = sd(d_resmem, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n_resmem),
    # Two-sided paired comparison with the original, using per-photo changes.
    p_vitmem = if (sum(!is.na(d_vitmem)) >= 2 &&
                    sd(d_vitmem, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
      t.test(d_vitmem, mu = 0)$p.value else NA_real_,
    p_resmem = if (sum(!is.na(d_resmem)) >= 2 &&
                    sd(d_resmem, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
      t.test(d_resmem, mu = 0)$p.value else NA_real_,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    ci_low = vitmem - qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * vitmem_se,
    ci_high = vitmem + qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * vitmem_se,
    resmem_ci_low = resmem - qt(0.975, df = n_resmem - 1) * resmem_se,
    resmem_ci_high = resmem + qt(0.975, df = n_resmem - 1) * resmem_se
  ) |>
  left_join(positions, by = "label") |>
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      is.na(p_vitmem) ~ "",
      p_vitmem < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_vitmem < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p_vitmem < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    significance_resmem = case_when(
      is.na(p_resmem) ~ "",
      p_resmem < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_resmem < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p_resmem < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    row_label = if_else(check_label == "After",
                        paste0(display_label, " (N = ", n, ")"), display_label),
    vitmem_text = sub("^-", "\u2212", sprintf("%+.3f", vitmem)),
    resmem_text = sub("^-", "\u2212", sprintf("%+.3f", resmem))
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(y))

stopifnot(nrow(plot_data) == nrow(positions), !anyNA(plot_data$y),
          all(plot_data$n >= 2), all(plot_data$n_resmem >= 2))
```

```{r appearance}
# Adjust these values to change the appearance.
text_size <- 6.5              # Text drawn inside the plot (ggplot units)
star_size <- 8              # Significance stars; increase or decrease as needed
title_size <- 13            # Title, legend and axis title (points)
axis_text_size <- 13
circle_size <- 5.5
diamond_size <- 5
diamond_stroke <- 0.9
ci_line_width <- 0.8
legend_icon_size <- 5       # Legend diamond size
legend_circle_size <- 5.5   # ViTMem legend circle size
legend_line_width <- 0.8
legend_key_width <- 0.9     # Centimetres; controls the available line length
vitmem_colour <- "#287BD7"
model_y_offset <- 0.16      # Separate the two models' intervals within each row
diamond_colour <- "#505050"
```

```{r legend-keys}
# Custom legend key: a horizontal interval with one central circle.
draw_key_vitmem <- function(data, params, size) {
  grobTree(
    segmentsGrob(
      x0 = unit(0.08, "npc"), x1 = unit(0.92, "npc"),
      y0 = unit(0.5, "npc"), y1 = unit(0.5, "npc"),
      gp = gpar(col = vitmem_colour, lwd = legend_line_width * .pt)
    ),
    pointsGrob(
      x = unit(0.5, "npc"), y = unit(0.5, "npc"), pch = 16,
      size = unit(legend_circle_size, "mm"),
      gp = gpar(col = vitmem_colour)
    )
  )
}
# Match the plotted ResMem interval and central hollow diamond.
draw_key_resmem <- function(data, params, size) {
  grobTree(
    segmentsGrob(
      x0 = unit(0.08, "npc"), x1 = unit(0.92, "npc"),
      y0 = unit(0.5, "npc"), y1 = unit(0.5, "npc"),
      gp = gpar(col = diamond_colour, lwd = legend_line_width * .pt)
    ),
    pointsGrob(
      x = unit(0.5, "npc"), y = unit(0.5, "npc"), pch = 23,
      size = unit(legend_icon_size, "mm"),
      gp = gpar(col = diamond_colour, fill = "white", lwd = diamond_stroke)
    )
  )
}
```

```{r plot, fig.width=16, fig.height=12, dpi=450}
# Independent panels give the labels and estimates a fixed boundary.
# Adjust these relative widths to change spacing without moving the data.
panel_widths <- c(labels = 3.4, estimates = 8.4, values = 3.8)
plot_x_limits <- c(-0.08, 0.135)
y_limits <- c(-4.1, 20.8)
header_y <- 20.1

# The full confidence intervals must fit inside the estimates panel.
stopifnot(min(plot_data$ci_low, plot_data$resmem_ci_low) > plot_x_limits[1],
          max(plot_data$ci_high, plot_data$resmem_ci_high) < plot_x_limits[2])

panel_theme <- theme_void(base_size = title_size) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(15, 0, 0, 0))

p_labels <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(y = y)) +
  geom_text(aes(x = if_else(group == "Method A", 0.22, 0.10),
                label = row_label), hjust = 0, size = text_size) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.02, y = header_y, label = "METHOD A",
           hjust = 0, fontface = "bold", colour = "#555555", size = text_size) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.02, y = 10.1, label = "METHOD B",
           hjust = 0, fontface = "bold", colour = "#555555", size = text_size) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.02, y = 6.6, label = "SIDOROV (2019)",
           hjust = 0, fontface = "bold", colour = "#555555", size = text_size) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.10, y = 18.95, label = "Before",
           hjust = 0, fontface = "bold", colour = "#555555", size = text_size) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.10, y = 14.75, label = "After",
           hjust = 0, fontface = "bold", colour = "#555555", size = text_size) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0), breaks = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits, expand = c(0, 0), breaks = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + panel_theme +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(15, 0, 0, 20))

reference_lines <- tibble(x = c(-0.05, 0, 0.05, 0.10))
axis_ticks <- tibble(x = c(-0.05, 0, 0.05, 0.10),
                     text = c("\u22120.05", "0", "+0.05", "+0.10"))
p_estimates <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(y = y)) +
  geom_segment(data = reference_lines,
               aes(x = x, xend = x, y = -3.15, yend = 20.55),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "#E7E7E3", linewidth = 0.4) +
  annotate("segment", x = 0, xend = 0, y = -3.15, yend = 20.55,
           colour = "#C8C8C1", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = resmem_ci_low, xend = resmem_ci_high,
                   y = y - model_y_offset, yend = y - model_y_offset),
               colour = diamond_colour, linewidth = ci_line_width,
               show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(aes(x = resmem, y = y - model_y_offset, shape = "ResMem change"),
             size = diamond_size, stroke = diamond_stroke,
             colour = diamond_colour, fill = "white",
             key_glyph = draw_key_resmem) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = ci_low, xend = ci_high,
                   y = y + model_y_offset, yend = y + model_y_offset),
               colour = vitmem_colour, linewidth = ci_line_width,
               show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(aes(x = vitmem, y = y + model_y_offset, shape = "ViTMem change"),
             colour = vitmem_colour, size = circle_size, key_glyph = draw_key_vitmem) +
  geom_text(data = axis_ticks, aes(x = x, y = -3.65, label = text),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = text_size, colour = "#555555") +
  scale_shape_manual(
    name = NULL,
    breaks = c("ViTMem change", "ResMem change"),
    values = c("ViTMem change" = 16, "ResMem change" = 23),
    labels = c("ViTMem change with 95% CI", "ResMem change with 95% CI"),
    guide = guide_legend(nrow = 1, override.aes = list(
      colour = c(vitmem_colour, diamond_colour), fill = c(vitmem_colour, "white"),
      size = c(legend_icon_size, legend_icon_size), stroke = c(0.5, diamond_stroke)
    ))
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = plot_x_limits, expand = c(0, 0), breaks = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits, expand = c(0, 0), breaks = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + panel_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom", legend.justification = "center",
    legend.box.just = "center", legend.margin = margin(t = 10, b = 15),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.key.width = unit(legend_key_width, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "cm")
  )

# Both models use the same two-sided paired t-test vs. original, unadjusted.
# Stars: * p < .05, ** p < .01, *** p < .001.
value_vitmem_x <- 0.30
value_resmem_x <- 0.82
value_star_gap <- 0.035
p_values <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(y = y)) +
  geom_text(aes(x = value_vitmem_x, label = vitmem_text),
            hjust = 1, size = text_size) +
  geom_text(aes(x = value_vitmem_x + value_star_gap,
                y = y - 0.12, label = significance),
            hjust = 0, size = star_size) +
  geom_text(aes(x = value_resmem_x, label = resmem_text),
            hjust = 1, size = text_size) +
  geom_text(aes(x = value_resmem_x + value_star_gap,
                y = y - 0.12, label = significance_resmem),
            hjust = 0, size = star_size) +
  annotate("text", x = value_vitmem_x, y = header_y, label = "ViTMem",
           hjust = 1, fontface = "bold", colour = "#555555", size = text_size) +
  annotate("text", x = value_resmem_x, y = header_y, label = "ResMem",
           hjust = 1, fontface = "bold", colour = "#555555", size = text_size) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0), breaks = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits, expand = c(0, 0), breaks = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) + panel_theme +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(15, 24, 0, 0))

legend <- cowplot::get_legend(p_estimates)
body <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  p_labels, p_estimates + theme(legend.position = "none"), p_values,
  nrow = 1, align = "h", axis = "tb", rel_widths = panel_widths
)
p <- cowplot::plot_grid(body, legend, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.065))
p
```

```{r save}
# Knit this file, or run all chunks including this one, to refresh the exports.
dir.create(export_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave(file.path(export_dir, "Figure_results_R.png"), p,
       width = 16, height = 12, dpi = 450, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(export_dir, "Figure_results_R.svg"), p,
       device = svglite::svglite, width = 16, height = 12, bg = "white")
dir.create(file.path(export_dir, "data"), showWarnings = FALSE)
write_csv(plot_data |> select(label, check_label, n, vitmem, ci_low, ci_high,
                              resmem, n_resmem, resmem_ci_low, resmem_ci_high, p_vitmem, significance,
                              p_resmem, significance_resmem),
          file.path(export_dir, "data", "Figure_results_summary.csv"))
```
